reason: I've never heard of them, and a paper cloud pendant for $360 looks like something I can find cheaper on Amazon or AliExpress. Even with 10% off I'd want to compare totals first, and I'd just close the tab.
objection: Unknown store, no way to see the quality of a paper-and-LED fixture, and I'd pay return shipping on a big pendant if I don't like it. I can probably find the same light cheaper elsewhere.
would_change_my_mind: A deeper first-order discount or promo code that beats the Amazon price, plus free returns and proof of reviews from real buyers.
